JHN_7_18: He who speaks of his own accord seeks glory for himself; but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and there is no deception in his heart.
JHN_7_19: Did not Moses give you the law? And yet no one of you obeys the law. Why do you want to kill me?
JHN_7_20: The people answered, saying, You are crazy; who wants to kill you?
JHN_7_21: Jesus answered, saying to them, I have done one work, and all of you marvel.
JHN_7_22: Moses gave you circumcision, not because it is from Moses, but because it is from the forefathers; and yet you circumcise a man on the sabbath.
JHN_7_23: So if a man is circumcised on the sabbath day, that the law of Moses may not be broken; yet you murmur at me, because I healed a whole man [Circumcision affected only one part of the body. Jesus here healed the whole body; and so his work on the Sabbath was more important than circumcision.] on the sabbath day?
JHN_7_24: Do not judge by partiality, but judge a just judgment.
JHN_7_25: Then some of the men of Jerusalem were saying, Is not this the man whom they want to kill?
JHN_7_26: And yet he speaks openly, but they say nothing to him. Perhaps our elders have found out that he is the Christ?
JHN_7_27: Howbeit we know whence he comes; but when the Christ comes, no man will know whence he comes.
JHN_7_28: Jesus then lifted up his voice as he taught in the temple, saying, You know me, and you know whence I come; and yet I have not come of my own accord, but he who sent me is true, whom you do not know.
JHN_7_29: But I know him; because I am from him, and he sent me.
JHN_7_30: So they wanted to seize him; and no man laid hands on him, because his time had not yet come.
JHN_7_31: But a great many of the people believed in him and said, When the Christ comes, will he do greater wonders than this man does?
JHN_7_32: ¶ The Pharisees heard the people talking about him; so they and the high priests sent soldiers to arrest him.
JHN_7_33: And Jesus said, I am with you just a short while, and I am going to him who sent me.
JHN_7_34: You will seek me, but you will not find me; and where I am you cannot come.
JHN_7_35: Then the Jews said among themselves, Where is he going, that we cannot find him? Is he planning to go to the countries of the Gentiles to teach the pagans?
JHN_7_36: What does this word mean which he said, You will seek me and you will not find me, and where I am you cannot come?
JHN_7_37: Now on the greatest day, which is the last day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, saying, If any man is thirsty, let him come to me and drink.
JHN_7_38: Whoever believes in me, just as the scriptures have said, the rivers of living water shall flow from within him.
JHN_7_39: He said this concerning the Spirit, which they who believe in him were to receive; for the Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
JHN_7_40: ¶ Many of the people who heard his words were saying, This man truly is a prophet.
JHN_7_41: Others were saying, He is the Christ; but others said, Is it possible that Christ should come from Galilee?
JHN_7_42: Does not the scripture say that Christ will come from the seed of David and from Bethlehem, the town of David?
JHN_7_43: So the people were divided because of him.
JHN_7_44: And there were some men among them who wanted to seize him; but no man laid hands on him.
JHN_7_45: ¶ And the soldiers returned to the high priests and the Pharisees; and the priests said to them, Why did you not bring him?
JHN_7_46: The soldiers said to them, Never a man has spoken as this man speaks.
JHN_7_47: The Pharisees said to them, What! have you also been deceived?
JHN_7_48: Have any of the leaders or of the Pharisees believed in him,
JHN_7_49: Except this cursed people who do not know the law?
JHN_7_50: Nicodemus, one of them, who had come to Jesus at night, said to them,
JHN_7_51: Does our law convict a man unless it first hears from him and knows what he has done?
JHN_7_52: They answered, saying to him, What! are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet will rise up from Galilee. [Galilee was the land of the Gentiles and of mixed races, the descendants of those who were transferred from Assyria during the captivity.]
JHN_7_53: So everyone went to his own house.
JHN_8_1: THEN Jesus went to the mount of Olives.
JHN_8_2: And in the morning he came again to the temple, and all the people were coming to him; and he sat down and taught them.
JHN_8_3: Then the scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman who was caught in adultery; [The story of the woman taken in adultery is not found in the ancient Peshitta, but occurs in later Aramaic texts.] and they made her to stand in the midst.
JHN_8_4: They said to him, Teacher, this woman was caught openly in the act of adultery.
JHN_8_5: Now in the law of Moses it is commanded that women such as these should be stoned; but what do you say?
JHN_8_6: They said this to tempt him, that they might have a cause to accuse him. While Jesus was bent down, he was writing on the ground.
JHN_8_7: When they were through questioning him, he straightened himself up and said to them, He who is among you without sin, let him first throw a stone at her.
JHN_8_8: And again as he bent down, he wrote on the ground.
JHN_8_9: And when they heard it, they left one by one, beginning with the elders; and the woman was left alone in the midst.
JHN_8_10: When Jesus straightened himself up, he said to the woman, Where are they? Did no man condemn you?
JHN_8_11: She said, No man, Lord. Then Jesus said, Neither do I condemn you; go away, and from henceforth, do not sin again.
JHN_8_12: ¶ Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, I am the light of the world; he who follows me shall not walk in darkness, but he shall find for himself the light of life.
JHN_8_13: The Pharisees said to him, You testify concerning yourself; your testimony is not true.
JHN_8_14: Jesus answered, saying to them, Even though I testify concerning myself, my testimony is true, because I know whence I came and whither I go; but you do not know whence I came or whither I go.
JHN_8_15: You judge according to the flesh; but I judge no man.
JHN_8_16: And if I should judge, my judgment is true; because I am not doing it alone, but I and my Father who sent me.
JHN_8_17: And it is written in your own law that the testimony of two men is true.
JHN_8_18: I testify concerning myself, and my Father who sent me testifies concerning me.
JHN_8_19: They said to him, Where is your Father? Jesus answered, saying to them, You know neither me nor my Father; if you knew me, you would know my Father also.
JHN_8_20: These words he spoke in the treasury while he taught in the temple; and no man arrested him, for his time had not yet come.
JHN_8_21: ¶ Jesus again said to them, I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins; and where I am going you cannot come.
JHN_8_22: The Jews said, What! will he kill himself? For he says, Where I am going, you cannot come.
JHN_8_23: And he said to them, You are from below, and I am from above; you are of this world, but I am not of this world.
JHN_8_24: I told you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.
JHN_8_25: The Jews said, Who are you? Jesus said to them, Even though I should begin to speak to you,
JHN_8_26: I have many things to say and to judge concerning you; but he who sent me is true; and I speak in the world only those things which I have heard from him.
JHN_8_27: They did not understand that he spoke to them concerning the Father.
JHN_8_28: Again Jesus said to them, When you have lifted up the Son of man, then you will understand that I am he, and I do nothing of my own accord; but as my Father has taught me, so I speak just like him.
JHN_8_29: And he who sent me is with me; and my Father has never left me alone, because I always do what pleases him.
JHN_8_30: ¶ While he was speaking these words, a great many believed in him.
JHN_8_31: Then Jesus said to the Jews who believed in him, If you abide by my word, you are truly my disciples.
JHN_8_32: And you will know the truth, and that very truth will make you free.
JHN_8_33: They said to him, We are the offspring of Abraham, and we have never been enslaved to any man; how do you say, You will be free people?
JHN_8_34: Jesus said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Whoever commits sin is a servant of sin.
JHN_8_35: And a servant does not remain in the house forever, but the son remains forever.
JHN_8_36: If therefore, the Son shall make you free, you shall be free indeed.
JHN_8_37: I know you are the descendants of Abraham; but still you want to kill me, because you have no room in you for my word.
JHN_8_38: I speak what I have seen with my Father; and you do what you have seen with your father.
JHN_8_39: They answered, saying to him, Our own father is Abraham. Jesus said to them, If you were the sons of Abraham, you would be doing the works of Abraham.
JHN_8_40: But behold, now you want to kill me, even a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God; this Abraham did not do.
JHN_8_41: But you do the works of your father. They said to him, We are not born of fornication; we have one Father, God.
JHN_8_42: Jesus said to them, If God were your Father, you would love me, for I proceeded and came from God; I did not come of my own accord, but he sent me.
JHN_8_43: Why therefore do you not understand my word? Because you cannot obey my word?
JHN_8_44: You are from the father of accusation, and you want to do the lusts of your father, he who is a murderer of men from the very beginning and who never stands by the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks he speaks his own lie, because he is a liar, and the father of lies.
JHN_8_45: But because I speak the truth, you do not believe me.
JHN_8_46: Which one of you can rebuke me because of sin? If I speak the truth, why do you not believe me?
JHN_8_47: He who is of God, hears God’s words; for this reason you do not hear, because you are not of God.
JHN_8_48: The Jews answered, saying to him, Did we not say well, that you are a Samaritan and that you are crazy?
JHN_8_49: Jesus said to them, I am not crazy; but I honor my Father, and you curse me.
JHN_8_50: I do not seek my glory; there is one who seeks and judges.
JHN_8_51: Truly, truly, I say to you, Whoever obeys my word shall never see death.
JHN_8_52: The Jews said to him, Now we are sure that you are insane. Abraham and the prophets have died; and yet you say, Whoever obeys my word shall never taste death.
JHN_8_53: What! are you greater than our father Abraham who died, and the prophets who died? Whom do you make yourself?
JHN_8_54: Jesus said to them, If I honor myself, my honor is nothing; but it is my Father who honors me, the one of whom you say, He is our God.
JHN_8_55: Yet you have not known him, but I know him; and if I should say, I do not know him, I would be a liar like yourselves; but I do know him, and I obey his word.
JHN_8_56: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day; and he saw it and was glad.
JHN_8_57: The Jews said to him, You are not yet fifty years old, and yet have you seen Abraham?
JHN_8_58: Jesus said to them, Truly, truly, I say to you, Before Abraham was born, I was.
JHN_8_59: So they took up stones, to stone him; and Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, and he passed through the midst of them and went away.
JHN_9_1: AND as Jesus passed by, he saw a man who was blind from his mother’s womb.
JHN_9_2: And his disciples asked him, saying, Teacher, who did sin, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?
JHN_9_3: Jesus said to them, Neither did he sin nor his parents. But that the works of God might be seen in him,
JHN_9_4: I must do the works of him who sent me, while it is day; the night comes when no man can work.
JHN_9_5: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.
JHN_9_6: When he said these words, he spat on the ground and mixed clay with his saliva, and he placed it on the eyes of the blind man.
JHN_9_7: Then he said to him, Go and wash in the baptismal pool of Shiloha. He went and washed, and he came seeing.
JHN_9_8: His neighbors and those who had seen him before begging, said, Is not this he who used to sit down and beg?
JHN_9_9: Some said, It is he; and some said, No, but he resembles him; but he said, I am he.
JHN_9_10: Then they said to him, How were your eyes opened?
JHN_9_11: He answered, saying to them, A man whose name is Jesus made clay and placed it on my eyes, and he said to me, Go and wash in the water of Shiloha; and I went and washed, and I see.
JHN_9_12: They said to him, Where is he? He said to them, I do not know.
JHN_9_13: ¶ So they brought to the Pharisees him who had been blind from his birth.
JHN_9_14: Now it was the sabbath when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
JHN_9_15: Again the Pharisees asked him, How did you receive your sight? He said to them, He placed clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see.
JHN_9_16: Then some of the Pharisees said, This man is not from God, because he does not observe the sabbath; others said, How can a man who is a sinner do these miracles? And there was a division among them.
JHN_9_17: They said to the blind man again, What do you say concerning him who opened your eyes? He said to them, I say he is a prophet.
JHN_9_18: But the Jews did not believe concerning him that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight.
JHN_9_19: And they asked them, Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?
JHN_9_20: His parents answered, saying, We know that he is our son and that he was born blind.
JHN_9_21: But how he sees now or who opened his eyes we do not know; he is of age, ask him, he will speak for himself.
JHN_9_22: His parents said these things because they were afraid of the Jews; for the Jews had decided already that if any man should confess that he is the Christ, they would put him out of the synagogue.
JHN_9_23: For this reason his parents said, He is of age, ask him.
JHN_9_24: So they called a second time the man who had been blind, and said to him, Give praise to God, for we know that this man is a sinner.
JHN_9_25: He answered, saying to them, If he is a sinner I do not know; but I do know one thing, that I was blind and now behold, I see.
JHN_9_26: They said to him again, What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?
JHN_9_27: He said to them, I have already told you, and you did not listen; why do you want to hear it again? What! do you also want to become his disciples?
JHN_9_28: Then they cursed him and said to him, You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
JHN_9_29: And we know that God spoke with Moses; but as for this man, we do not know whence he is.
JHN_9_30: The man answered, saying to them, This is surprising, that you do not know whence he is, and yet he opened my eyes.
JHN_9_31: We know that God does not hear the voice of sinners; but he hears the one who reveres him and does his will.
JHN_9_32: From ages it has never been heard that a man opened the eyes of one who was born blind.
JHN_9_33: If this man were not from God, he could not have done this.
JHN_9_34: They answered, saying to him, You were wholly born in sins, and yet do you teach us? And they cast him out.
JHN_9_35: ¶ And Jesus heard that they had cast him out; and he found him and said to him, Do you believe in the Son of God?
JHN_9_36: He who was healed answered, saying, Who is he, my Lord, so that I may believe in him?
JHN_9_37: Jesus said to him, You have seen him, and he is the one who is speaking with you.
JHN_9_38: He said, I do believe, my Lord; and he fell down and worshipped him.
JHN_9_39: Then Jesus said to him, I have come for the judgment of this world, so that those who cannot see may see, and those who see may become blind.
JHN_9_40: ¶ When some of the Pharisees who were with him heard these words, they said to him, What! are we also blind?
JHN_9_41: Jesus said to them, If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, We see; because of this your sin remains.
JHN_10_1: TRULY, truly, I say to you, He who does not enter by the door into the sheepfold, but climbs up from another place, is a thief and a bandit.
JHN_10_2: But he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
JHN_10_3: To him the doorkeeper opens the door, and the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by their names and brings them out.
JHN_10_4: And when he has brought out his sheep, [His sheep refers to the several flocks in the fold; his own sheep refers to his own flock.] he goes before them; and his own sheep follow him, because they know his voice.
JHN_10_5: The sheep do not follow a stranger, but they run away from him, because they do not know the voice of a stranger.
JHN_10_6: Jesus spoke this parable to them; but they did not understand what he was telling them.
JHN_10_7: Jesus said to them again, Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
JHN_10_8: All who have come are thieves and bandits, if the sheep did not hear them.
JHN_10_9: I am the door; if any man enter by me, he shall live and he shall come in and go out and find pasture.
JHN_10_10: A thief does not come, except to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they might have life, and have it abundantly.
JHN_10_11: I am the good shepherd; a good shepherd risks his life for the sake of his sheep.
JHN_10_12: But the hired person who is not the shepherd and who is not the owner of the sheep, when he sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep and runs away; and the wolf comes and seizes and scatters the sheep.
JHN_10_13: The hired person runs away because he is hired and does not care for the sheep.
JHN_10_14: I am the good shepherd, and I know my own, and my own know me.
JHN_10_15: Just as my Father knows me, I also know my Father; and I lay down my life for the sake of the sheep.
JHN_10_16: I have other sheep also, which are not of this fold; them too I must bring, and they will hear my voice; and all the sheep will become one flock and one shepherd.
JHN_10_17: This is why my Father loves me, because I lay down my life so that I may take it up again.
JHN_10_18: No man takes it away from me, but I lay it down of my own will. Therefore I have the power to lay it down, and I have the power to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.
JHN_10_19: ¶ There was again a division among the Jews because of these sayings.
JHN_10_20: And many of them said, He is insane and rambles; why do you listen to him?
JHN_10_21: Others said, These are not the words of a crazy man. Can a crazy man open the eyes of the blind?
JHN_10_22: ¶ Then came the feast of dedication at Jerusalem, and it was winter.
JHN_10_23: And Jesus was walking in the temple in Solomon’s porch.
JHN_10_24: Then the Jews surrounded him and said to him, How long do you vex our soul with uncertainty? If you are the Christ, tell us openly.
JHN_10_25: Jesus answered, saying to them, I have told you, but you do not believe; yet the works which I do in the name of my Father testify of me.
JHN_10_26: But you do not believe, because you are not of my sheep, just as I told you.
JHN_10_27: My own sheep hear my voice, and I know them and they follow me;
JHN_10_28: And I give to them eternal life; and they will never perish, and no man will snatch them from my hands.
JHN_10_29: For my Father who gave them to me is greater than all; and no man can snatch anything from my Father’s hand.
JHN_10_30: I and my Father are of one accord.
JHN_10_31: Then the Jews again took up stones to stone him.
JHN_10_32: Jesus said to them, I have shown you many good works from my Father; for which one of them do you stone me?
JHN_10_33: The Jews said to him, It is not because of the good works we stone you, but because you blaspheme; for while you are only a man, you make yourself God.
JHN_10_34: Jesus said to them, Is it not so written in your law, I said, you are gods?
JHN_10_35: If he called them gods because the word of God was with them (and the scripture cannot be broken)
JHN_10_36: Why to the one whom the Father sanctified and sent to the world, do you say, You blaspheme, just because I said to you, I am the Son of God.
JHN_10_37: If I am not doing the works of my Father, do not believe me.
JHN_10_38: But if I am doing them, even though you do not believe in me, believe in the works, so that you may know and believe that my Father is with me and I am with my Father.
JHN_10_39: ¶ And they wanted again to seize him; but he escaped from their hands.
JHN_10_40: And he went away to the Jordan crossing, to the place where John was, where he first baptized; and he remained there.
JHN_10_41: And many men came to him and said, John did not perform a single miracle; but everything which John said concerning this man is true.
JHN_11_1: NOW there was a man who was sick, Lazar of the town of Bethany, the brother of Mary and Martha.
JHN_11_2: This is the Mary who anointed the feet of Jesus with perfume and wiped them with her hair. The Lazar who was sick was her brother.
JHN_11_3: His two sisters therefore sent to Jesus, saying, Our Lord, behold, the one whom you love is sick.
JHN_11_4: Jesus said, This is not a sickness of death, but for the sake of the glory of God, that the Son of God may be glorified on his account.
JHN_11_5: Now Jesus loved Martha and Mary and Lazar.
JHN_11_6: When he heard he was sick, he remained two days in the place where he was.
JHN_11_7: After that he said to his disciples, Come, let us go again to Judea.
JHN_11_8: His disciples said to him, Teacher, not long ago the Jews wanted to stone you, and yet are you going there again?
JHN_11_9: Jesus said to them, Are there not twelve hours in the day? If a man walks by daytime, he will not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
JHN_11_10: But if a man travels at nighttime, he will stumble, because there is no light in it.
JHN_11_11: Jesus said these things; and after that he said to them, Our friend Lazar is asleep; but I am going to awaken him.
JHN_11_12: His disciples said to him, Our Lord, if he is sleeping, he will get well.
JHN_11_13: But Jesus spoke of his death; and they thought that what he said was sleeping in bed.
JHN_11_14: Then Jesus said to them plainly, Lazar is dead;
JHN_11_15: And I am glad I was not there, for your sakes, so that you may believe; but let us walk there.
JHN_11_16: Then Thomas, who is called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, Let us also go and die with him.
JHN_11_17: ¶ So Jesus came to Bethany, and he found that Lazar had been four days in the tomb.
JHN_11_18: Now Bethany was towards Jerusalem, a distance of about two miles.
JHN_11_19: And many Jews kept coming to Martha and Mary to comfort their hearts concerning their brother.
JHN_11_20: When Martha heard that Jesus had come, she went out to meet him; but Mary sat in the house.
JHN_11_21: Then Martha said to Jesus, My Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
JHN_11_22: But even now I know that whatever you ask of God, he will give you.
JHN_11_23: Jesus said to her, Your brother will rise up.
JHN_11_24: Martha said to him, I know he will rise up in the resurrection at the last day.
JHN_11_25: Jesus said to her, I am the resurrection and the life; he who believes in me, even though he die, he shall live.
JHN_11_26: And whoever is alive and believes in me shall never die. Do you believe this?
JHN_11_27: She said to him, Yes, my Lord; I do believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, who is to come to the world.
JHN_11_28: And when she had said these things, she went away and called her sister Mary secretly and said to her, Our teacher has come, and he is calling for you.
JHN_11_29: When Mary heard it, she rose up quickly and came to him.
JHN_11_30: Jesus had not yet come into the town, but he was still at the same place where Martha met him.
JHN_11_31: The Jews also who were with her in the house, comforting her, when they saw Mary rise up quickly and go out, followed her, for they thought she was going to the tomb to weep.
JHN_11_32: When Mary came where Jesus was and saw him, she threw herself at his feet and said to him, My Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
JHN_11_33: When Jesus saw her weeping and the Jews weeping, who had come with her, he was moved in his spirit and was greatly disturbed.
JHN_11_34: And he said, Where have you laid him? They said to him, Our Lord, come and see.
JHN_11_36: The Jews then said, See how much he loved him!
JHN_11_37: Some of them said, Could not this man, who opened the eyes of that blind man, have also kept this man from dying?
JHN_11_38: As Jesus was disturbed in himself because of them, he came to the tomb. That tomb was a cave, and a stone was placed at the entrance.
JHN_11_39: Jesus said, Take away this stone. Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, My Lord, already his body stinks, for he has been dead four days.
JHN_11_40: Jesus said to her, Did not I say to you that if vow believe, you will see the glory of God?
JHN_11_41: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted his eyes upwards and said, O Father, I thank thee for thou hast heard me,
JHN_11_42: And I know that thou always hearest me; but I say these things just because of this people who stand around, so that they may believe that thou hast sent me.
JHN_11_43: And when he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, Lazar, come out.
JHN_11_44: And the dead man came out, his hands and feet bound with burial clothes, and his face bound with a burial napkin. Jesus said to them, Loose him and let him go.
JHN_11_45: ¶ Many of the Jews who had come to Mary, when they saw what Jesus had done, believed in him.
JHN_11_46: And some of them went to the Pharisees and told them everything Jesus had done.
JHN_11_47: ¶ So the high priests and the Pharisees gathered together and said, What shall we do? For this man does many miracles.
JHN_11_48: If we allow him to continue like this, all men will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take over both our country and our people.
JHN_11_49: But one of them, called Caiaphas, who was the high priest for that year, said to them, You know nothing;
JHN_11_50: Nor are you reasoning that it is much better for us that one man should die instead of the people, and not all the people perish.
JHN_11_51: He did not say this of himself; but because he was the high priest for that year, he prophesied that Jesus had to die for the sake of the people;
JHN_11_52: And not only for the sake of the people, but also to gather together the children of God who are scattered abroad.
JHN_11_53: And from that very day, they decided to kill him.
JHN_11_54: ¶ Jesus therefore did not walk openly among the Jews, but went away thence to a place which is close to the wilderness, in the province of Ephraim; and he remained there with his disciples.
JHN_11_55: Now the Jewish passover was at hand; and many went up from the towns to Jerusalem, before the feast, to purify themselves.
JHN_11_56: And they were looking for Jesus, and at the temple they kept saying to one another, What do you think, will he not come to the feast?
JHN_11_57: But the high priests and the Pharisees had already commanded that if any man should know where he was, he should let them know, so that they might seize him.
JHN_12_1: SIX days before the passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazar was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
JHN_12_2: And they gave him a banquet there; Martha served; but Lazar was one of the guests who were with him.
JHN_12_3: Then Mary took a cruse containing pure and expensive nard. and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair; and the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
JHN_12_4: And Judah of Iscariot, one of his disciples, who was about to betray him, said,
JHN_12_5: Why was not this oil sold for three hundred pennies, and given to the poor?
JHN_12_6: He said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and the purse was with him, and he carried whatever was put into it.
JHN_12_7: Jesus then said, Let her alone; she has kept it for the day of my burial.
JHN_12_8: For you have the poor always with you, but me you have not always.
JHN_12_9: ¶ Many people of the Jews heard that Jesus was there; so they came, not only on account of Jesus, but also to see Lazar, whom he had raised from the dead.
JHN_12_10: And the high priests were thinking of killing Lazar also;
JHN_12_11: Because on his account a great many Jews were leaving and believing in Jesus.
JHN_12_12: ¶ On the next day, a large crowd which had come to the feast when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
JHN_12_13: Took branches of palm trees, and went out to greet him, and they cried out and said, Hosanna, Blessed is the king of Israel who comes in the name of the Lord.
JHN_12_14: And Jesus found an ass and sat on it; as it is written,
JHN_12_15: Fear not, O daughter of Zion; behold, your king comes to you, riding on the colt of an ass.
JHN_12_16: His disciples did not understand these things at that time; but when Jesus was glorified, then his disciples remembered that these things were written concerning him and that they had done these things to him.
JHN_12_17: The people who were with him testified that he had called Lazar from the tomb and raised him from the dead.
JHN_12_18: It was on this account that large crowds went out to meet him, for they heard that he had performed this miracle.
JHN_12_19: The Pharisees said one to another, Do you see that you have not been able to gain anything? Behold, all the people have gone after him.
JHN_12_20: ¶ Now there were some Gentiles [The Aramaic ammey means Gentiles, that is, Syrians, Idumaeans, and other neighboring peoples. The word for Greeks is yonaye.] among them who had come up to worship at the feast.
JHN_12_21: They came and approached Philip of Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, My lord, we would like to see Jesus.
JHN_12_22: Philip came and told Andrew; then Andrew and Philip told Jesus.
JHN_12_23: Jesus answered, saying to them, The hour has come that the Son of man should be glorified.
JHN_12_24: Truly, truly, I say to you that unless a grain of wheat falls and dies in the ground, it will be left alone; but if it dies, it produces much fruit.
JHN_12_25: He who loves his life will lose it; and he who has no concern for his life in this world will keep it to life eternal.
JHN_12_26: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there also will my servant be; he who serves me, him my Father will honor.
JHN_12_27: Now my soul is disturbed, and what shall I say? O my Father, deliver me from this hour; but for this cause I came to this very hour.
JHN_12_28: O Father, glorify thy name. Then a voice was heard from heaven, I am glorified, and I shall again be glorified.
JHN_12_29: And the people who stood by heard it and said, It was thunder; others said, An angel spoke to him.
JHN_12_30: Jesus answered, saying to them, This voice was not on my account, but for your sake.
JHN_12_31: Now is the judgment of this world; now the leader of this world will be cast out.
JHN_12_32: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw every man to me.
JHN_12_33: He said this to show by what kind of death he was to die.
JHN_12_34: The people said to him, We have heard from the law that the Christ shall remain forever; how do you say that the Son of man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?
JHN_12_35: Jesus said to them, The light is with you for a little while; walk while you have the light, so that the darkness may not overcome you; and he who walks in the darkness does not know where he goes.
JHN_12_36: While you have the light, believe in the light, so that you may become the sons of the light. Jesus spoke these things, and went away and hid himself from them.
JHN_12_37: ¶ Even though he had performed all of these miracles before them, yet they did not believe in him,
JHN_12_38: So that the word of the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled, who said, My Lord, who will believe our report, and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?
JHN_12_39: For this reason, they could not believe, because Isaiah said again,
JHN_12_40: Their eyes have become blind and their hearts darkened, so that they cannot see with their eyes and understand with their hearts; let them return and I will heal them.
JHN_12_41: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory and spoke concerning him.
JHN_12_42: Many of the leading men also believed in him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess it, so that they might not be cast out of the synagogue.
JHN_12_43: For they loved the honor of men more than the glory of God.
JHN_12_44: ¶ Jesus cried out, saying, He who believes in me believes not in me but in him who sent me.
JHN_12_45: And he who sees me has already seen him who sent me.
JHN_12_46: I have come into the world as the light, so that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
JHN_12_47: And he who hears my words, and does not obey them, I will not judge him; for I have not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
JHN_12_48: He who oppresses me and does not receive my words, there is one who will judge him; the word which I have spoken, it will judge him at the last day.
JHN_12_49: For I did not speak of myself; but the Father who sent me, he commanded me what to say and what to speak.
JHN_12_50: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting; these things therefore which I speak, just as my Father told me, so I speak.
JHN_13_1: NOW before the feast of the passover, Jesus knew the hour had come to depart from this world to his Father. He loved his own who were in this world, and he loved them to the end.
JHN_13_2: ¶ During supper, Satan put into the heart of Judah, son of Simon of Iscariot, to deliver him.
JHN_13_3: But Jesus, because he knew that the Father had given everything into his hands and that he came from God and was going to God,
JHN_13_4: Rose from supper and laid aside his robe; and he took a cloth and tied it around his loins.
JHN_13_5: Then he poured water into a basin, and began to wash the feet of his disciples and to wipe them with the cloth which was tied around his loins.
JHN_13_6: When he came to Simon Peter, Simon said to him, Are you, my Lord, going to wash my feet?
JHN_13_7: Jesus answered, saying to him, What I am doing, you do not know now, but later you will understand.
JHN_13_8: Then Simon Peter said to him, You will never wash my feet. Jesus said to him, If I do not wash you, you have no part with me.
JHN_13_9: Simon Peter said to him, Then, my Lord, wash not only my feet but also my hands and my head.
JHN_13_10: Jesus said to him, He who has bathed does not need except to wash his feet only, for he is already all clean; so you are all clean, but not everyone of you.
JHN_13_11: For Jesus knew him who was to betray him; therefore he said, Not everyone of you is clean.
JHN_13_12: When he had washed their feet, he put on his robes and sat down; and he said to them, Do you know what I have done to you?
JHN_13_13: You call me Teacher and Lord; and what you say is well, for I am.
JHN_13_14: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, how much more should you wash one another’s feet?
JHN_13_15: For I have given you this as an example, so that just as I have done to you, you should also do.
JHN_13_16: Truly, truly, I say to you, There is no servant who is greater than his master; and no apostle who is greater than he who sent him.
JHN_13_17: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
JHN_13_18: I do not say this concerning all of you, for I know those whom I have chosen; but that the scripture might be fulfilled, He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.
JHN_13_19: I tell you now before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he. [The Messiah.]
JHN_13_20: Truly, truly, I say to you, He who receives him whom I send receives me; and he who receives me receives him who sent me.
JHN_13_21: ¶ Jesus said these things, and he was disturbed in spirit, and testified, saying, Truly, truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me.
JHN_13_22: The disciples then looked at each other, because they did not know concerning whom he spoke.
JHN_13_23: Now there was one of his disciples who was leaning on his bosom, the one whom Jesus loved.
JHN_13_24: Simon Peter beckoned to him, to ask him of whom he spoke.
JHN_13_25: So that disciple leaned himself on the breast of Jesus, and said to him, My Lord, who is he?
JHN_13_26: Jesus answered, saying, The one for whom I dip bread and give it to him. So Jesus dipped the bread, and gave it to Judah, the son of Simon of Iscariot.
JHN_13_27: And after the bread, Satan took possession of him. So Jesus said to him, What you are going to do, do it soon.
JHN_13_28: But no man of those who were sitting at the table understood what he said to him.
JHN_13_29: For some of them thought, because the purse was with Judah, that he ordered him to buy what was needed for the feast or to give something to the poor.
JHN_13_30: So Judah then received the bread and went outside immediately; and it was night when he went out.
JHN_13_31: ¶ Jesus then said, Now the Son of man is glorified, and God is glorified by him.
JHN_13_32: If God is glorified by him, God will also glorify him by himself, and he will glorify him at once.
JHN_13_33: My sons, I am with you yet a little while, and you will seek me. And just as I said to the Jews, Where I go you cannot come; the same I now tell you also.
JHN_13_34: A new commandment I give you, that you love one another; just as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
JHN_13_35: By this every man shall know that you are my disciples, if you have love one for another.
JHN_13_36: Simon Peter said to him, Our Lord, where are you going? Jesus answered, saying to him, Where I go you cannot follow me now, but you will follow later.
JHN_13_37: Simon Peter said to him, My Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will even lay down my life for you.
JHN_13_38: Jesus said to him, Will you lay down your life for me? Truly, truly, I say to you, The cock shall not crow, until you have denied me three times.
JHN_14_1: LET not your heart be troubled; believe in God, and believe in me also.
JHN_14_2: In my Father’s house are many rooms; if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.
JHN_14_3: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and take you to me, so that where I am you may be also.
JHN_14_4: You know where I am going and you know the way.
JHN_14_5: Thomas said to him, Our Lord, we do not know where you are going; and how can we know the way?
JHN_14_6: Jesus said to him, I am the way and the truth and the life; no man comes to my Father except by me.
JHN_14_7: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also; from henceforth you know him and you have seen him.
JHN_14_8: Philip said to him, Our Lord, show us the Father, and that is enough for us.
JHN_14_9: Jesus said to him, All this time I have been with you, and yet you do not know me, Philip? He who sees me has seen the Father; and how do you say, Show us the Father?
JHN_14_10: Do you not believe that I am with my Father and my Father is with me? The words that I speak, I do not speak of myself; but my Father who abides with me does these works.
JHN_14_11: Believe that I am with my Father and my Father is with me; and if not, believe because of the works.
JHN_14_12: Truly, truly, I say to you, He who believes in me shall do the works which I do; and even greater than these things he shall do, because I am going to my Father.
JHN_14_13: And whatever you ask in my name, I will do it for you, so that the Father may be glorified through his Son.
JHN_14_14: If you ask me in my own name, I will do it.
JHN_14_15: If you love me, keep my commandments.
JHN_14_16: And I will ask of my Father, and he will give you another Comforter, to be with you for ever,
JHN_14_17: Even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it has not seen him and does not know him; but you know him because he abides with you and is in you.
JHN_14_18: I will not leave you bereaved, for I will come to you after a little while.
JHN_14_19: And the world will not see me, but you will see me; because I live, you shall live also.
JHN_14_20: In that day you will know that I am with my Father, and you are with me, and I am with you.
JHN_14_21: He who has my commandments with him and obeys them is the one who loves me; he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and reveal myself to him.
JHN_14_22: Judah (not of Iscariot) said to him, My Lord, why is it that you will reveal yourself to us and not to the world?
JHN_14_23: Jesus answered, saying to him, He who loves me keeps my word; and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make a place of abode with him.
JHN_14_24: But he who does not love me does not keep my word; and this word which you hear is not my own but the Father’s who sent me.
JHN_14_25: I have spoken these things to you while I am with you.
JHN_14_26: But the Comforter, the Holy Spirit, whom my Father will send in my name will teach you everything, and remind you of everything which I tell you.
JHN_14_27: Peace I leave with you; my own peace I give you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Let not your heart be troubled and do not be afraid.
JHN_14_28: You heard that I told you, I am going away, and I will come to you. If you loved me, you would rejoice because I am going to my Father; for my Father is greater than I.
JHN_14_29: And now behold, I have told you before it happens, so that when it does happen, you may believe.
JHN_14_30: Hereafter I will not talk much with you; for the prince of this world comes; and yet he has nothing against me.
JHN_14_31: But that the world may know that I love my Father, and as my Father has commanded me, so I do. Arise, let us go away from here.
JHN_15_1: I AM the true vine, and my Father is the laborer.
JHN_15_2: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit, he cuts off; and the one which bears fruit, he prunes so that it may bring forth more fruit.
JHN_15_3: You have already been pruned because of the word which I have spoken to you.
JHN_15_4: Remain with me and I with you. Just as a branch cannot give fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, even so you cannot unless you remain with me.
JHN_15_5: I am the vine, you are the branches. He who remains with me, and I with him, will bear abundant fruit; for without me you can do nothing.
JHN_15_6: Unless a man remains with me, he will be cast outside like a branch which is withered, which they pick up and throw into the fire to be burned.
JHN_15_7: If you remain with me, and my words remain with you, whatever you ask shall be done for you.
JHN_15_8: In this the Father will be glorified, that you bear abundant fruit and be my disciples.
JHN_15_9: ¶ Just as my Father has loved me, I also have loved you; abide in my love.
JHN_15_10: If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and abide in his love.
JHN_15_11: I have spoken these things to you that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be full.
JHN_15_12: This is my commandment: That you love one another just as I have loved you.
JHN_15_13: There is no greater love than this, that a man lay down his life for the sake of his friends.
JHN_15_14: You are my friends if you do everything that I command you.
JHN_15_15: Henceforth I will not call you servants, because a servant does not know what his master does; but I have always called you my friends, because everything that I heard from my Father I have made known to you.
JHN_15_16: You did not choose me, but I chose you, and I have appointed you, that you also should go and produce fruit and that your fruit might remain, so that whatever you ask my Father in my name, he will give it to you.
JHN_15_17: I command these things to you so that you may love one another.
JHN_15_18: If the world hates you, know well that it has hated me before you.
JHN_15_19: If you were of the world, the world would love its own; but you are not of the world for I have chosen you out of the world; this is why the world hates you.
JHN_15_20: Remember the word which I said to you, that no servant is greater than his master. If they have persecuted me, they will also persecute you; if they kept my word, they will also keep yours.
JHN_15_21: But they will do all these things to you for the sake of my name, because they do not know him who sent me.
JHN_15_22: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would be without sin; but now they have no excuse for their sins.
JHN_15_23: He who hates me hates my Father also.
JHN_15_24: If I had not done works before their eyes, such as no other man has ever done, they would be without sin; but now they have seen and hated me and also my Father,
JHN_15_25: So that the word which is written in their law may be fulfilled, They hated me for no reason.
JHN_15_26: But when the Comforter comes, whom I will send to you from my Father, the Spirit of truth which proceeds from my Father, he will testify concerning me.
JHN_15_27: And you also will testify because you have been with me from the beginning.
JHN_16_1: I HAVE spoken these things to you so that you may not stumble.
JHN_16_2: For they will put you out of their synagogues; and the hour will come that whoever kills you will think that he has offered an offering to God.
JHN_16_3: And these things they will do because they have not known my Father, nor me.
JHN_16_4: I have spoken these things to you that when their time does come, you may remember them, and that I told you. And these things I did not tell you before because I was with you.
JHN_16_5: ¶ But now I am going to him who sent me, and yet no one of you asks me, Where are you going?
JHN_16_6: But because I told you these things, sorrow has come and filled your hearts.
JHN_16_7: But I tell you the truth, It is better for you that I should go away; for if I do not go away, the Comforter will not come to you; but if I should go, I will send him to you.
JHN_16_8: And when he is come, he will rebuke the world concerning sin, concerning righteousness, and concerning judgment;
JHN_16_9: Concerning sin, because they do not believe in me;
JHN_16_10: Concerning righteousness, because I go to my Father and you will not see me again;
JHN_16_11: Concerning judgment, because the leader of this world has been judged.
JHN_16_12: Again, I have many other things to tell you, but you cannot grasp them now.
JHN_16_13: But when the Spirit of truth is come, he will guide you into all the truth; for he will not speak from himself, but what he hears he will speak; and he will make known to you things which are to come in the future.
JHN_16_14: He will glorify me, because he will take of my own and show it to you.
JHN_16_15: Everything that my Father has is mine; this is the reason why I told you that he will take of my own and show it to you.
JHN_16_16: A little while, and you will not see me; and again a little while, and you will see me, because I am going to the Father.
JHN_16_17: Then his disciples said to one another, What is this that he said to us, A little while, and you will not see me; and again a little while, and you will see me; and, because I am going to my Father?
JHN_16_18: And they said, What is this that he said, A little while? We cannot understand what he talks about.
JHN_16_19: Jesus knew that they desired to ask him, and he said to them, Are you inquiring among yourselves concerning this that I told you, A little while, and you will not see me; and again a little while, and you will see me?
JHN_16_20: Truly, truly, I say to you that you will weep and wail, and yet the world will rejoice; and you will be sad, but your sadness will be changed into gladness.
JHN_16_21: When a woman is in travail, she is depressed because her day has arrived; but when she has given birth to a son, she no longer remembers her troubles because of the joy that a male [When a girl is born in the East, the news is kept from the mother for a while if she is in danger. If a boy is born she is at once informed to cheer her up.] child is born into the world.
JHN_16_22: So you also are depressed; but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and your joy no man will take away from you.
JHN_16_23: In that day you will not ask me anything. Truly, truly, I say to you that whatever you ask my Father in my name, he will give it to you.
JHN_16_24: Hitherto you have asked nothing in my name; ask and you will receive, so that your joy may be full.
JHN_16_25: I have spoken these things in figures; but the time is coming when I will not speak to you in figures, but will plainly explain to you concerning the Father.
JHN_16_26: In that day you will ask in my name; and I will not say to you, I will ask the Father concerning you.
JHN_16_27: For the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came forth from the Father.
JHN_16_28: I came forth from the Father and I came into the world; again, I am leaving the world and I am going to the Father.
JHN_16_29: His disciples said to him, Behold, now you speak plainly and do not utter a single figure.
JHN_16_30: Now we understand that you know everything, and you need no man to ask you; by this we believe that you have come forth from God.
JHN_16_32: For behold, the hour is coming, and it has now come, when you will be dispersed, every man to his own country, and you will leave me alone; and yet I am never alone because the Father is with me.
JHN_16_33: These things I have said to you that in me you may have peace. In the world you will have tribulation; but have courage, I have conquered the world.
JHN_17_1: JESUS spoke these things, and then he lifted up his eyes to heaven and said, O my Father, the hour has come; glorify thy Son, so that thy Son may glorify thee,
JHN_17_2: Since thou hast given him power over all flesh, so that to all whom thou hast given him, he may give life eternal.
JHN_17_3: And this is life eternal, that they might know thee, that thou art the only true God, even the one who sent Jesus Christ.
JHN_17_4: I have already glorified thee on the earth; for the work which thou hadst given to me to do, I have finished.
JHN_17_5: So now, O my Father, glorify me with thee, with the same glory which I had with thee before the world was made.
JHN_17_6: I have made thy name known to the men whom thou gavest me out of the world; they were thine and thou gavest them to me; and they have kept thy word.
JHN_17_7: Now they know that whatever thou hast given me is from thee.
JHN_17_8: For the words which thou gavest me I gave them; and they accepted them, and have known truly that I came forth from thee, and they have believed that thou hast sent me.
JHN_17_9: What I request is for them; I make no request for the world, but for those whom thou hast given to me; because they are thine.
JHN_17_10: And everything which is mine is thine; and what is thine is mine; and I am glorified by them.
JHN_17_11: Hereafter I am not in the world, but these are in the world; and I am coming to thee. O holy Father, protect them in thy name, which thou hast given me, that they may be one, even as we are.
JHN_17_12: While I was with them in the world, I protected them in thy name; those whom thou gavest me I protected, and not one of them is lost except the son of perdition, that the scripture might be fulfilled.
JHN_17_13: Now I am coming to thee; and these things I speak while I am in the world, that my joy may be complete in them.
JHN_17_14: I have given them thy word; and the world hated them, because they were not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
JHN_17_15: What I request is not that thou shouldst take them out of the world, but that thou shouldst protect them from evil.
JHN_17_16: For they are not of the world, just as I am not of the world.
JHN_17_17: O Father, sanctify them in thy truth, because thy word is truth.
JHN_17_18: Just as thou didst send me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
JHN_17_19: And for their sakes, I am sanctifying myself, so that they also may be sanctified in the truth.
JHN_17_20: I am not making request for these alone, but also for the sake of those who believe in me through their word.
JHN_17_21: So that they all may be one; just as thou, my Father, art with me, and I am with thee, that they also may be one with us; so that the world may believe that thou didst send me.
JHN_17_22: And the glory which thou gavest me, I gave to them; so that they may be one just as we are one.
JHN_17_23: I with them and thou with me, that they may become perfected in one; so that the world may know that thou didst send me, and that thou didst love them just as thou didst love me.
JHN_17_24: O Father, I wish that those whom thou hast given me may also be with me where I am, so that they may see my glory which thou hast given me; for thou hast loved me before the foundation of the world.
JHN_17_25: O my righteous Father, the world did not know thee, but I have known thee; and these have known that thou hast sent me.
JHN_17_26: And I have made thy name known to them, and I am still making it known, so that the love with which thou hast loved me may be among them, and I be with them.
JHN_18_1: JESUS said these things and went out with his disciples across the brook Kidron, to a place where there was a garden, where he and his disciples entered.
JHN_18_2: Judah the traitor also knew that place, for Jesus and his disciples frequently gathered there.
JHN_18_3: Judah, therefore, took a company of soldiers and also guards from the high priests and the Pharisees, and he came there with torches and lamps and weapons.
JHN_18_4: Jesus, knowing everything that was to happen, went out and said to them. Whom do you want?
JHN_18_5: They said to him, Jesus the Nazarene. Jesus said to them, I am he. Judah the traitor was also standing with them.
JHN_18_6: When Jesus said to them, I am he, they drew back and fell to the ground.
JHN_18_7: Jesus again asked them, Whom do you want? They said, Jesus the Nazarene.
JHN_18_8: Jesus said to them, I have told you that I am he; if then you want me, let these men go away;
JHN_18_9: (That the word which he said might be fulfilled, Of those whom thou gavest me, I have lost not even one).
JHN_18_10: But Simon Peter had a sword, and he drew it and struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Maleck.
JHN_18_11: And Jesus said to Peter, Put the sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the cup which my Father has given me?
JHN_18_12: ¶ Then the soldiers and the captains and the Jewish guards seized Jesus and bound him.
JHN_18_13: And they brought him first to Hanan, because he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was the high priest of that year.
JHN_18_14: Caiaphas was the one who had counselled the Jews that it was better for one man to die instead of the people.
JHN_18_15: Simon Peter and one of the other disciples followed Jesus. The high priest knew that disciple, so he entered with Jesus into the courtyard.
JHN_18_16: But Simon stood outside near the door. Then the other disciple, whom the high priest knew, went out and told the portress, and brought in Simon.
JHN_18_17: The young portress then said to Simon, Are you also one of the disciples of this man? He said to her, No.
JHN_18_18: And the servants and guards were standing and making a fire to warm themselves because it was cold; Simon also stood with them and warmed himself.
JHN_18_19: The high priest then questioned Jesus concerning his disciples and concerning his teaching.
JHN_18_20: Jesus said to him, I have spoken openly to the people, and I have always taught in the synagogue and in the temple where all Jews assemble; and I have spoken nothing secretly.
JHN_18_21: Why do you ask me? Ask those who heard what I have spoken to them; behold, they know everything which I said.
JHN_18_22: And as he said these things, one of the guards who stood by struck Jesus on his cheek and said to him, Is this how you answer the high priest?
JHN_18_23: Jesus answered, saying to him, If I have spoken any evil, testify to the evil; but if it is good, why did you strike me?
JHN_18_24: Hanan then sent Jesus bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
JHN_18_25: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said to him, What! are you also one of his disciples? He denied and said, I am not.
JHN_18_26: Then one of the servants of the high priest, a kinsman of him whose ear Simon had cut off, said to him, Did I not see you with him in the garden?
JHN_18_27: Simon again denied it; and at that very hour the cock crowed.
JHN_18_28: ¶ Then they brought Jesus from Caiaphas to the Praetorium; and it was morning; and they did not enter into the Praetorium, so that they might not be defiled before they ate the passover.
JHN_18_29: Pilate then went outside where they were, and said to them, What accusation do you have against this man?
JHN_18_30: They answered, saying to him, If he were not an evildoer, we would not have delivered him up to you.
JHN_18_31: Then said Pilate to them, Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your own law. The Jews said to him, We have no power to kill a man;
JHN_18_32: So that the word which Jesus had said might be fulfilled, when he signified by what kind of death he was to die.
JHN_18_33: Pilate then entered into the Praetorium, and called Jesus and said to him. Are you the King of the Jews?
JHN_18_34: Jesus said to him, Do you say this of yourself or have others told it to you concerning me?
JHN_18_35: Pilate said to him, Why, am I a Jew? Your own people and the high priests have delivered you to me; what have you done?
JHN_18_36: Jesus said to him, My kingdom is not of this world; if my kingdom were of this world, my servants would have fought so that I should not be delivered to the Jews; but now my kingdom is not from here.
JHN_18_37: Pilate said to him, Then are you a king? Jesus said to him, You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this very thing I came to the world, that I may bear witness concerning the truth. Whoever is of the truth will hear my voice.
JHN_18_38: Pilate said to him, What is this truth? And as he said this, he went out again to the Jews and said to them, I am unable to find even one cause against him.
JHN_18_39: You have a custom that I should release to you one at the passover; do you wish, therefore, that I release to you this King of the Jews?
JHN_18_40: They all cried out saying, Not him, but Bar-Abba. Now this Bar-Abba was a bandit.
JHN_19_2: And the soldiers wove a crown of thorns and placed it on his head, and they covered him with purple robes;
JHN_19_3: And they said, Peace be to you, O King of the Jews! and they struck him on his cheeks.
JHN_19_4: Pilate again went outside and said to them, Behold, I bring him outside to you, so that you may know that I find not even one cause against him.
JHN_19_5: So Jesus went outside, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robes. And Pilate said to them, Behold the man!
JHN_19_6: When the high priests and the guards saw him, they cried out, saying, Crucify him, crucify him! Pilate said to them, You take him and crucify him; for I find no cause in him.
JHN_19_7: The Jews said to him, We have a law, and according to our law he is guilty of death because he made himself the Son of God.
JHN_19_8: When Pilate heard this saying, he was the more afraid;
JHN_19_9: So he entered again into the Praetorium, and said to Jesus, Where do you come from? But Jesus gave him no answer.
JHN_19_10: Pilate said to him, Will you not speak even to me? Do you not know that I have the authority to release you, and I have the authority to crucify you?
JHN_19_11: Jesus said to him, You would have no authority whatever over me if it had not been given to you from above; for this reason the sin of him who delivered me to you is greater than yours.
JHN_19_12: And because of this Pilate wanted to release him; but the Jews cried out, If you release this man you are not a friend of Caesar; for whoever makes himself a king is against Caesar.
JHN_19_13: When Pilate heard this word, he brought Jesus outside; then he sat down on the judgment seat at a place which is called the Stone Pavement, but in Hebrew it is called Gabbatha.
JHN_19_14: It was Friday of the passover, and it was about six o’clock; and he said to the Jews, Behold your king!
JHN_19_15: But they cried out, Take him away, take him away, crucify him, crucify him! Pilate said to them, Shall I crucify your king? The high priests said to him, We have no king but Caesar.
JHN_19_16: Then he delivered him to them to crucify him. So they took Jesus and brought him forth,
JHN_19_17: Carrying his cross, to the place which is called The Skull, but in Hebrew it is called Golgotha,
JHN_19_18: Where they crucified him, and with him two others, one on either side, and Jesus between.
JHN_19_19: Pilate also wrote on a stone tablet, and placed it on his cross. And the writing was, THIS IS JESUS THE NAZARENE, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
JHN_19_20: And a great many Jews read this tablet, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew and in Greek and in Roman.
JHN_19_21: The high priests then said to Pilate, Do not write that he is the King of the Jews; but that he said, I am the King of the Jews.
JHN_19_22: Pilate said, What I have written I have written.
JHN_19_23: ¶ Now when the soldiers had crucified Jesus, they took his clothes and divided them into four parts, a part to each of the soldiers; but his robe was without seam, woven from the top throughout.
JHN_19_24: So they said one to another, Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to see whose it shall be. And the scripture was fulfilled, which said, They divided my clothes among them, and for my robe they cast lots. These things the soldiers did.
JHN_19_25: ¶ Now there were standing by the cross of Jesus his mother and his mother’s sister and Mary of Cleopas and Mary of Magdala.
JHN_19_26: When Jesus saw his mother and the disciple whom he loved standing, he said to his mother, Woman, behold your son!
JHN_19_27: Then he said to the disciple, Behold your mother! And from that very hour the disciple took her with him.
JHN_19_28: After these things Jesus knew that everything was now accomplished; and that the scripture might be fulfilled, he said, I thirst.
JHN_19_29: Now there was a pitcher full of vinegar placed there; so they filled a sponge with vinegar and put it on the point of a reed and placed it on his mouth.
JHN_19_30: ¶ When Jesus drank the vinegar, he said, It is fulfilled; and he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
JHN_19_31: Now since it was Friday the Jews said, Let not these bodies remain on their crosses because the sabbath is dawning; for that sabbath was a great sabbath. So they besought Pilate to have the legs of those who were crucified broken, and to have the bodies lowered down.
JHN_19_32: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who was crucified with him.
JHN_19_33: But when they came to Jesus, they saw that he was dead already, so they did not break his legs.
JHN_19_34: But one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.
JHN_19_35: And he who saw it testified, and his testimony is true; and he knows well that what he said is true, that you also may believe.
JHN_19_36: For these things happened that the scripture might be fulfilled, which said, Not even a bone shall be broken in him;
JHN_19_37: And again another scripture which said, They shall look on him whom they pierced.
JHN_19_38: ¶ After these things Joseph of Ramtha, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because of fear of the Jews, besought Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus. And Pilate granted him permission. So he came and took away the body of Jesus.
JHN_19_39: And there came also Nicodemus, who at first had come to Jesus by night; and he brought with him a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pints.
JHN_19_40: So they took away the body of Jesus and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, according to the custom of the Jews in burial.
JHN_19_41: Now there was a garden in the place where Jesus was crucified; and in the garden a new tomb, in which no man was yet laid.
JHN_19_42: So they laid Jesus there, because the sabbath was approaching and because the tomb was near.
JHN_20_1: ON the first day of the week, early in the morning, while it was yet dark, Mary of Magdala came to the tomb; and she saw that the stone was removed from the tomb.
JHN_20_2: Then she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and she said to them, They have taken our Lord out of that tomb, and I do not know where they have laid him.
JHN_20_3: So Simon and the other disciple went out and came to the tomb.
JHN_20_4: And they were both running together; but that disciple outran Simon and came first to the tomb.
JHN_20_5: And he looked in and saw the linen cloths lying; but he did not enter in.
JHN_20_6: Then Simon came after him and entered into the tomb; and he saw the linen cloths lying there,
JHN_20_7: And the burial napkin which was bound around his head was not with the linen cloths, but was wrapped up and put in a place by itself.
JHN_20_8: Then the other disciple who had come first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.
JHN_20_9: For they did yet not understand from the scripture that he had to rise from the dead.
JHN_20_10: So the disciples went away again to their lodging place.
JHN_20_11: ¶ But Mary was standing near the tomb weeping; and as she wept, she looked into the tomb;
JHN_20_12: And she saw two angels in white sitting one at the head and the other at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.
JHN_20_13: And they said to her, Woman, why do you weep? She said to them, Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid him.
JHN_20_14: She said this and turned around and saw Jesus standing, but she did not know that it was Jesus.
JHN_20_15: Jesus said to her, Woman, why do you weep? and whom do you want? She thought he was the gardener, so she said to him, My lord, if you are the one who has taken him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will go and take him away.
JHN_20_16: Jesus said to her, Mary. She turned around and said to him in Hebrew, Rabbuli! which means, My Teacher!
JHN_20_17: Jesus said to her, Do not come near me; for I have not yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brethren and say to them, I am ascending to my Father and your Father, and my God and your God.
JHN_20_18: Then Mary of Magdala came and brought glad tidings to the disciples, that she had seen our Lord and that he had told her these things.
JHN_20_19: ¶ When it was evening on that first day of the week, and the doors were shut where the disciples were staying for fear of the Jews, Jesus came, stood among them, and said to them, Peace be with you.
JHN_20_20: He said this, and then he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples rejoiced when they saw our Lord.
JHN_20_21: Then Jesus said to them again, Peace be with you; just as my Father has sent me, so I send you.
JHN_20_22: And when he had said these things, he encouraged them and said to them, Receive the Holy Spirit.
JHN_20_23: if you forgive a man his sins, they shall be forgiven to him; and if you withhold forgiveness of a man’s sins, they are kept.
JHN_20_24: ¶ But Thomas, one of the twelve, who is called the Twin, was not there with them when Jesus came.
JHN_20_25: And the disciples said to him, We have seen our Lord. He said to them, Unless I see in his hands the marks of the nails, and put my fingers in them, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.
JHN_20_26: Eight days later, the disciples were again indoors, and Thomas with them. Jesus came, when the doors were locked, and stood in the midst, and said to them, Peace be with you.
JHN_20_27: Then he said to Thomas, Put your finger here, and see my hands; and reach out your hand and put it into my side; and be not faithless, but believing.
JHN_20_28: Thomas answered, saying to him, O my Lord and my God!
JHN_20_29: Jesus said to him, Now you believe because you have seen me? Blessed are those who have not seen me, and have believed.
JHN_20_30: ¶ Many other miracles Jesus did in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;
JHN_20_31: Even these are written, so that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God; and when you believe you shall have life everlasting in his name.
JHN_21_1: AFTER these things, Jesus showed himself again to his disciples by the sea of Tiberias; and he appeared in this way:
JHN_21_2: They were all together, Simon Peter and Thomas who is called the Twin and Nathanael of Cana of Galilee and the sons of Zebedee and two others of the disciples.
JHN_21_3: Simon Peter said to them, I am going to catch fish. They said to him, We also will come with you. So they went out and climbed up into the boat; and that night they caught nothing.
JHN_21_4: When morning came Jesus stood by the seaside; and the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
JHN_21_5: So Jesus said to them, Boys, have you got anything to eat? They said to him, No.
JHN_21_6: He said to them, Throw your net on the right side of the boat, and you will find fish. So they threw it, and they were not able to draw the net because of the many fish which it had caught.
JHN_21_7: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, That is our Lord. When Simon heard that it was our Lord, he took his cloak and girded it around his waist, because he was naked; and he jumped into the sea to come to Jesus.
JHN_21_8: But the other disciples came by boat; for they were not very far from land, but about a hundred yards, and they were dragging the net of fish.
JHN_21_9: When they landed, they saw burning coals set, and a fish laid on them, and bread.
JHN_21_10: Jesus said to them, Bring some of the fish which you have now caught.
JHN_21_11: So Simon Peter went up and drew the net to land, full of large fishes, one hundred and fifty-three; and in spite of this weight, the net did not break.
JHN_21_12: Jesus said to them, Come, break your fast. But not one of the disciples dared to ask him who he was, for they knew he was our Lord.
JHN_21_13: Then Jesus drew near, and took bread and fish and gave to them.
JHN_21_14: This is the third time that Jesus appeared to his disciples after he rose up from the dead.
JHN_21_15: ¶ When they had broken their fast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these things? He said to him, Yes, my Lord, you know that I love you. Jesus said to him, Feed my lambs.
JHN_21_16: He said to him again the second time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me? He said to him, Yes, my Lord, you know that I love you. Jesus said to him, Feed my sheep.
JHN_21_17: He said to him again the third time, Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me? It grieved Peter because he said to him the third time, Do you love me? So he said to him, My Lord, you understand well everything, you know that I love you. Jesus said to him, Feed my ewes.
JHN_21_18: Truly, truly, I say to you, when you were young, you tied up your girdle yourself, and walked wherever you pleased; but when you become old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will tie up for you your girdle and take you where you do not wish to go.
JHN_21_19: He said this to show by what death he would glorify God. And when he had said these things, he said to him, Follow me.
JHN_21_20: Simon Peter turned around and saw the disciple whom Jesus loved following him, the one who leaned on the breast of Jesus at the supper and said, My Lord, who will betray you?
JHN_21_21: When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, My Lord, what about him?
JHN_21_22: Jesus said to him, If I wish him to remain until I come, what difference does that make to you? You follow me.
JHN_21_23: This word then went out among the brethren, that that disciple would not die. But what Jesus said was not that he would not die, but, If I wish that he should remain until I come back, what difference does that make to you?
JHN_21_24: This is the disciple who testified concerning all of these things and who also wrote them; and we know that his testimony is true.
JHN_21_25: There are also a great many other things which Jesus did, which, if they were written one by one, not even this world, I believe, could contain the books that would be written.
REV_1_1: THE Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave to him to show to his servants those things which must soon come to pass; he sent and signified it by his angel to his servant John,
REV_1_2: Who bore record of the word of God and of the testimony of Jesus Christ and of all things that he saw.
REV_1_3: Blessed is he who reads and they who listen to the words of this prophecy and keep those things which are written in it; for the time is at hand.
REV_1_4: ¶ John to the seven churches which are in Asia: Grace be to you and peace from him who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits which are before his throne;
REV_1_5: And from Jesus Christ, who is the faithful witness, and the first to arise from the dead, and the prince of the kings of the earth. To him who loved us and washed us from our sins in his own blood,
REV_1_6: And has made us a spiritual kingdom to God and his Father, to him be glory and dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
REV_1_7: ¶ Behold he will come with the clouds; and every eye shall see him, even the men who pierced him; and all the kindreds of the earth shall wail over him. Even so, Amen.
REV_1_8: I am Aleph and Tau, the beginning and the ending says the Lord God, who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.
REV_1_9: ¶ I, John, your brother and companion in suffering and in the hope of Jesus Christ, was in the island which is called Patmos because of the word of God and because of the testimony of Jesus Christ.
REV_1_10: The Spirit of prophecy came upon me on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a great voice, as of a trumpet, saying,
REV_1_11: What you see, write in a book and send it to the seven churches, to Ephesus and to Smyrna and to Pergamos and to Thyatira and to Sardis and to Philadelphia and to Laodicea.
REV_1_12: And I turned to see the voice that spoke to me. And as I turned, I saw seven golden candlesticks,
REV_1_13: And in the midst of the seven candlesticks one resembling the Son of man, wearing a long vestment and girded round his breast with a golden girdle.
REV_1_14: His head and his hair were white as wool, as white as snow; and his eyes were as a flame of fire;
REV_1_15: And his feet were like the fine brass of Lebanon, as though they were burned in a furnace; and his voice was as the sound of many waters.
REV_1_16: And he had in his right hand seven stars; and out of his mouth came a sharp two-edged sword; and his countenance was like the sun shining in its strength.
REV_1_17: And when I saw him, I fell at his feet as dead. And he laid his right hand upon me, saying, Fear not; I am the first and the last;
REV_1_18: I am he who lives, and was dead; and, behold, I am alive for evermore. Amen. And I have the keys of death and of Sheol.
REV_1_19: Write, therefore, the things which you have seen and the things which are and the things which shall be hereafter,
REV_1_20: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden candlesticks. The seven stars are the angels of the seven churches and the seven candlesticks are the seven churches.
REV_2_1: TO the angel [Angel in this case means the appointed head of the church.] of the church of Ephesus write: These things says the Omnipotent One who holds the seven stars in his right hand, who walks in the midst of the seven golden candlesticks.
REV_2_2: I know your works and your labour and your patience and how you cannot endure those who are ungodly; you have tried those who say they are apostles and are not, and you have found them liars;
REV_2_3: And you have patience, and have borne burdens for my name’s sake, and have not wearied.
REV_2_4: Nevertheless I have something against you, because you have left your first love.
REV_2_5: Remember therefore from whence you have fallen and repent and do the first works; or else I will come to you very soon, and I will remove your candlestick from its place unless you repent.
REV_2_6: But this you have in your favour, you hate the works of the Nicolaitanes, which I also hate.
REV_2_7: He who has ears, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: To him who overcomes, I will give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of my God.
REV_2_8: ¶ And to the angel of the church in Smyrna write: These things says the first and the last, which was dead and is alive:
REV_2_9: I know your works and your suffering and poverty, but you are rich, and I know the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews and are not, but are of the synagogue of Satan.
REV_2_10: Fear none of those things which you shall suffer; behold, the devil will cast some of you into prison, that you be tried; and you will be oppressed for ten days. Be faithful even to death, and I will give you a crown of life.
REV_2_11: He who has ears, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: He who overcomes shall not be hurt by the second death.
REV_2_12: ¶ And to the angel of the church in Pergamos write: These things says he who has the sharp two-edged sword:
REV_2_13: I know your works and where you dwell, even where Satan’s seat is; and you uphold my name, and you did not deny my faith, even in those days when that witness of mine appeared, that faithful one of mine who was slain among you, where Satan dwells.
REV_2_14: But I have a few things against you because you have there those who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to cast a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols and to commit adultery.
REV_2_15: And also you have those among you who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitanes.
REV_2_16: Repent; or else I will come to you very soon and will fight against them with the sword of my mouth.
REV_2_17: He who has ears, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches: To him who overcomes, I will give to eat of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written, which no man knows except he who receives it.
REV_2_18: ¶ And to the angel of the church in Thyatira write: These things says the Son of God, who has eyes like a flame of fire, and whose feet are like fine brass from Lebanon;
REV_2_19: I know your works and love and faith and service, and also your patience; and your last works are to be more abundant than the first.
REV_2_20: Notwithstanding I have a few things against you because you allowed that woman of yours, Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess, to teach and to seduce my servants to commit fornication and to eat things sacrificed to idols.
REV_2_21: And I gave her time to repent, but she did not repent from her fornication.
REV_2_22: Behold I will cast her into a sick bed and those who commit adultery with her into great tribulation, unless they repent of their deeds.
REV_2_23: And I will smite her children with death; and all the churches shall know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts; and I will give to everyone of you according to your works.
